## About the project

Codebase Workflow Skills is a collection of reusable agent skills for common software-engineering workflows. The skills help investigate a repository, reason about proposed changes, and communicate findings grounded in project evidence.

Invoke them during typical workflows by making them discoverable by coding agents such as Codex and GitHub Copilot. 

## Workflows covered

The collection contains seven skills covering repository understanding, change planning, architecture visualization, test design, code review, documentation assessment, and Git change summaries.

Each skill can be used independently, depending on the task. The shared approach emphasizes scoped investigation, evidence-based findings, and read-only behavior by default.

## Current state

This project is an initial proof of concept. All seven skills have defined workflows. Setup and invocation tooling are not yet included.
